set.body:
Outcome: a completed run cannot conceal unavailable measurement rows in the ordinary summary.
Scope: MappingPipeline.inspect/artifacts, existing status/reason producers, relevant exchange readers and tests; reuse existing retained outcomes.
Acceptance: attempted/prepared/run-produced counts and declared unit denominators reconcile to all retained records. Preparation failures without an inventory remain observation failures with unknown unit counts, never invented zero-unit measurements. For each member retain processing status, measure availability, unavailable reason, overflow and uniform-information accounting as separate fields; diagnostic counts need not be exclusive and must say so. Do not label candidate-set size as gold candidate recall. Expose participant/session accounting; only aggregate by condition with an explicit validated grouping. Existing organization summaries preserve original adjacency denominators without bridging gaps; this does not launch the deferred organization product. Empty/all-failed/mixed batches, overflow and measured-uniform rows have independent expected totals and reader round trips. Missing ratios remain absent for zero/unknown denominators, and equal participant weighting versus pooled-unit weighting is explicitly identified whenever aggregation is supplied. No eligibility or automatic deletion of failed rows.
Evidence: extend MappingPipelineSuite and relevant exchange/reader courts; a deliberate dropped unavailable/failed row must fail denominator reconciliation. Preserve underlying mapping numeric bytes. Finish with one synthetic command-to-summary example.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
set.title: [mapping audit A] Reconcile measured-unit coverage in ordinary batch summaries
